Field-origin investigations

by Alexander Panasenko · xrefcode.com
On this page
  1. What the evidence means
  2. Keep hints separate from witnesses
  3. Select a slice explicitly
  4. Budgets and limitations

Available starting with v0.2.0. The JSON CLI and the local MCP xref_query tool share this operation. The inspected binary is never executed.

JSON
{
  "operation": "field_origin",
  "request": {
    "address": "0x1000",
    "register": "rdi",
    "offsets": ["0x18", "0x28"],
    "callees": true
  }
}

Replace the example address with a file-backed FDE returned for your image. The selected register denotes its value at FDE entry, not a recovered source parameter or a stack-frame layout. Accepted names are the existing layout registers: rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx, r8, r9, rbx, rbp and r12 through r15.

What the evidence means

accesses contains reachable machine memory operations whose effective address is derived from the selected entry register under the declared static model. Each row carries its displacement, width in bytes, instruction address/bytes, alias-definition instructions and an optional via call hop. The access mode is read, write, read_write or address; conditional accesses have a separate flag. A compare reads memory; a read/modify/write operation has mode read_write. Vector accesses retain their observed width. A LEA has mode address and width zero, rather than pretending to load the pointed-to value.

calls records values available in SysV integer argument-register candidates at each relevant instruction. These are register facts, not recovered arity or proof that every register is consumed by a callee. Each argument has one of:

  • base_address: the selected entry value with zero displacement;
  • field_address: an address relative to that entry value;
  • loaded_value: an unmodified value read by a specific MOV instruction, with load_address and load_width_bytes.

A loaded pointer is not treated as the original base. Passing a base does not prove that a particular field is forwarded. With callees: true, a known callee entry can be inspected using the proven register/address relationship. Only its actual memory instruction then provides evidence for an access at the combined root-relative displacement. The via object preserves caller, call-site, target, callee register and base displacement. Loaded-value arguments do not start a pointee traversal.

For example, a call may receive root+0x10 while its callee accesses +0x8. The resulting access is reported at root+0x18. Address-register candidates are therefore retained even when their displacement does not match offsets; requested_offset_match makes this explicit. Loaded-value arguments are filtered to the requested offsets. With no offset filter this property is null. Filters accept at most eight nonnegative hexadecimal offsets fitting i64. Unfiltered evidence may also contain negative displacements, written as -0x.... No object size, allocation bound or source-language type is inferred.

Calls include necessary direct-CFG guard edges and the instructions defining their flags. Unknown control flow suppresses certified origins and guards; an unreachable site is not reported as a witnessed call. Individual memory rows describe possible reachable operations, not proof that a branch executed on a particular runtime input. Root entry registers can alias in reality; unproven memory/base relationships remain counted as unresolved.

Keep hints separate from witnesses

layout_hints reuses the existing linear layout scanner for root offset, width and stride candidates. Every row is explicitly tagged heuristic_path_insensitive_not_a_type_or_forwarding_proof. These hints are separate from CFG-derived instruction witnesses. They do not establish that a field was passed through a call, nor recover a C/Rust struct.

The CFG facts currently propagate full-width register copies, simple entry-relative LEA and ADD/SUB-immediate addresses, and plain 32/64-bit MOV loads. Unsupported transformations, subword writes, dynamic indices, FS/GS contributions, address-size-32 accesses, vector-value forwarding, stack-spill aliases and arithmetic on loaded values become unknown. Implicit string memory operands are counted as unresolved rather than emitted as certified accesses. Different or missing origins at joins are not conflated. The model assumes SysV volatile-register clobbers and returning calls; exceptional unwinding and arbitrary indirect targets remain outside it. Facts are relative to an FDE range, which may be only part of a source-level function.

Select a slice explicitly

Discovery does not render a slice. Copy a returned calls[].selection object into the same request's selection field. It contains image_sha256, function and call_site. A different image digest is rejected; a site not reached by this bounded field investigation is not silently substituted.

The selected exact instruction is sliced by the existing renderer. The slice evidence step carries typed text, warnings, errors and UTF-8 pagination. If it is a fragment, continue with the ordinary slice operation, the selected function/site and the returned byte offset. Selection can refer to a witnessed root call or a call inside an admitted one-hop callee scope. Raw assembly is also available through asm using the reported function/instruction addresses.

Budgets and limitations

Defaults: 20 rows per access/call/hint list, four callee scopes, 32768 output bytes, 4096 slice bytes. The limits object accepts rows 1..40, callees 0..4, output_bytes 4096..48000 and slice_bytes 4..8192. Callee analysis is one hop; distinct call sites/register mappings remain separate scopes. Retained forwarding calls beyond that hop produce callee_depth_limit; loaded-value pointees instead produce loaded_value_pointee_not_followed. Unreachable instructions are excluded from counters only when the CFG is complete; an unknown dispatch keeps the potential instructions in scope. Each scope supports at most 32 KiB of code, 2048 decoded instructions and 100000 dataflow work items. Definitions are capped at eight per fact; guards use the existing bounded search and 96 inline evidence rows.

stops, scope_errors, unresolved_memory_operands and per-witness definitions_truncated / guards_complete expose gaps. The serialized output cap preserves admitted evidence. List limits do not provide an automatic page cursor: narrow offsets, select a returned callee as a new root, or adjust limits explicitly. complete_under_model is not a proof of global completeness or absence of a relationship; inspect all per-witness flags too. This operation does not answer an unknown business-flow entry-point question, prove runtime ordering or establish that deferred work is absent.
